explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.empty: Nothing to browse yet. Inventory arrives with the explorer features.

panel.empty: Nothing to show here yet. This view fills in when the feature that owns it arrives.

tree.label: Explorer tree
tree.truncated: The list is longer than the tree shows.

editor.inactive: Select a tab in this group to show it here.
editor.emptyGroup: Open something from the explorer to add a tab to this group.

notice.absent: No saved layout for this connection yet. The default layout is shown.
notice.invalid: The saved layout could not be used. The default layout is shown and the saved one is kept until you change the layout.
notice.newerVersion: The saved layout was written by a newer version of the app. The default layout is shown and the saved one is kept until you change the layout.
notice.tabsDropped: Some tabs of the saved layout were left out because their address does not belong to this connection.
notice.overLimit: The saved layout is larger than this version allows. The default layout is shown and the saved one is kept until you change the layout.
notice.loadFailed: The saved layout could not be loaded. The default layout is shown and nothing is saved until you change the layout.

refusal.groups: No more editor groups can be opened.
refusal.tabsPerGroup: This group has the most tabs it can hold. Close one first.
refusal.tabsTotal: The most tabs are open. Close one first.
refusal.urlTooLong: That address is too long to keep as a tab.
refusal.labelTooLong: That tab title is too long to keep.
refusal.unsafeUrl: That address does not belong to this connection and was not opened as a tab.
refusal.documentTooLarge: The layout would be larger than the engine accepts. Close a tab first.

saveFailed.title: The layout could not be saved. It stays as it is in this window.
saveFailed.loadTitle: The saved layout could not be loaded.
